lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters organized into distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-regular grid pattern with longitudinal spacing between columns increasing towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity approximately 5-10 pixels in width that intersect with high-luminance circular blobs, creating a lattice of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and shadow-induced low-intensity pixels on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an elongated, dark-pixel silhouette (remora) positioned ventrally to the pectoral fin area.
